articles.summary: At AIM Expo's Dealer Excellence main stage, Ekho co-founder Rowan Mockler shared data and perspective on why the powersports industry needs to meet younger buyers where they are — online. From the aging buyer demographic to the lifetime value of a first-time online purchaser, this piece distills the key takeaways for dealers looking to future-proof their business.
articles.title: Capturing Customers Who Don't Want to Come In

articles.summary: Ekho has been named to the 2026 Powersports Business Nifty 50, ranking #16 overall and earning the top spot among dealership technology platforms. The recognition highlights Ekho's impact on dealer profitability through its Sales Agent, AI-native dealer websites, 50-state transaction engine, and unified dealer platform.
articles.title: Ekho Named to the 2026 Powersports Business Nifty 50 as the Top-Ranked Dealer Tech Platform
